description: Resumable tracker for the production-finalization / gap-completion pass on the unified-tracking npm package. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on.
stack: npm package — Capacitor plugin + framework-agnostic TypeScript library; unified analytics + error-tracking facade over 8 analytics (Google/Firebase/Amplitude/Mixpanel/Segment/PostHog/Heap/Matomo) + 8 error providers (Sentry/Crashlytics/DataDog/Bugsnag/Rollbar/LogRocket/Raygun/AppCenter). Web/JS delivery layer is the shipped (3.3.0) path; native iOS/Android SDK bridges are on-branch + unverified. Build: tsc (NodeNext ESM). Lint: ESLint + Prettier. No runtime deps.

verifyCommands.note: Package-style verify. `yarn prettier --check` fails ONLY on .java native files (pre-existing prettier-plugin-java parser gap); TS/JS code style is clean. No automated test suite (removed 2026-06-03 per global policy).
